title: The flatness functor is an fpqc sheaf and limit preserving
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the functor of points over which a module is flat is an fpqc sheaf, and is limit preserving under finite presentation hypotheses (statement lines 6441-6450, tag 05MD-adjacent). The proof reduces the sheaf property to the equivalence of flatness under a surjective flat base change and the limit preserving statement to the descent of flatness for a finitely presented module after an affine reduction. The two reductions are the substance, so the claim is H2.
